description: The pie chart, titled "6 Matches," displays the distribution of data across six distinct categories, each represented by a colored slice and labeled with a number from 0 to 5. The largest segment, colored light blue, corresponds to category 0 and accounts for 27.2% of the total (8006 units). The second largest segment, in a pale yellow-green, represents category 2, making up 22.4% of the total (6583 units). Category 1, shown in a light beige, comprises 13.8% of the data (4046 units), while category 0, in a pale cream color, accounts for 13.3% (3910 units). The remaining categories are smaller: category 5, in a light sky blue, represents 10.4% (3043 units); category 4, in a very light blue, accounts for 6.2% (1810 units); and category 3, in a pale olive green, makes up 6.8% (2002 units). Each slice is clearly labeled with its corresponding category number, percentage, and raw count, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top.
